convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for CronexCCI indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade execution, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh for smoothing methods). Custom indicator with proprietary smoothing algorithms cannot be auto-converted without reimplementing the indicator logic.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup
derived_values.formula: CCIPeriod + GetStartBars(XMA_Method, FastPeriod, XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method, SlowPeriod, XPhase) + 3 + SignalBar

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position opening

other_exits: Buy positions closed when main line crosses below signal line (Ind[1]<Sign[1] triggers BUY_Close)
Sell positions closed when main line crosses above signal line (Ind[1]>Sign[1] triggers SELL_Close)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum controls sizing: FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss, LOT=fixed lot size. When MMMode=LOT, MM value (0.1) is interpreted as fixed lot size.

custom_logic_notes: Signal detection uses bar[SignalBar] (default=1, previous bar) for crossover detection: Ind[1]>Sign[1] on previous-previous bar AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] on previous bar triggers buy signal (main crossed above signal). UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime is set to current bar open time for trade execution timing. Recount flag forces signal recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. LoadHistory() ensures sufficient bar data is loaded before processing. GlobalVariableDel_() cleans up global variables on deinit. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans independently control whether each direction's entry and exit signals are active.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of: (1) CronexCCI custom indicator - CCI smoothed by XMA method with fast/slow smoothing, using SmoothAlgorithms.mqh smoothing functions (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA in addition to standard MAs); (2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions - BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar class. The MMMode (MarginMode) enum controls 5 different position sizing methods that must each be reimplemented. Signal crossover logic uses 2-bar lookback (bars [SignalBar] and [SignalBar+1]) and is straightforward once indicator buffers are available. New-bar guard via CIsNewBar prevents intrabar re-entry. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - may need 5-digit adjustment depending on broker.
